stem: Aling Rosa has 2 kilos of sugar. She packs it into small bags of 1/4 kilo each. How many bags can she fill?
hints: Ask first: how many 1/4-kilo bags can 1 kilo fill?
1 kilo is 4 quarters, so 1 kilo fills 4 bags.
She has 2 kilos. Multiply the number of bags for 1 kilo by the number of kilos.

solution.methodName: Dividing by a fraction: count how many fit

steps.action: Find how many 1/4-kilo bags 1 kilo fills: 4 bags.
steps.why: 1/4 means 1 of 4 equal parts. So 1 kilo splits into 4 parts of 1/4 kilo.
Each kilo fills 4 bags, so 2 kilos fill twice as many.
Dividing by 1/4 is the same as multiplying by 4.

trapNotes.4: This is the number of bags for 1 kilo only. She has 2 kilos.
trapNotes.6: This adds 2 + 4. Each kilo fills 4 bags, so multiply 2 × 4.
trapNotes.1/2: This multiplies 2 × 1/4. That gives the weight of 2 small bags in kilos, not the number of bags.
